# Handy Tax Guy

> > A practical tax preparation resource offering free checklists, tips, and guidance for individuals navigating tax planning and compliance.

Handy Tax Guy provides accessible tax preparation resources and educational content to help individuals understand and optimize their tax strategies. The site leverages ConvertKit for email-based distribution of tax tips and checklists to subscribers.

## Key Topics

- tax-preparation
- tax-planning
- tax-tips
- free-checklist
- email-signup
- beginner-guide
- Handy Tax Guy
- ConvertKit

## Tax Resources & Checklists

- [Get Proven Tax Tips Straight to Your Inbox!](https://www.handytaxguy.com/freechecklistfortaxes): Free tax checklist and tips signup via Handy Tax Guy's email list
